job.title: Junior Technical Product Owner Webshop (m/w/d) B2B-Versandhandel

tailoring.headline: Technical Product Owner – B2B Webshop & SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in API design, PIM/ERP/MDM integration, requirement engineering, stakeholder management and agile delivery using Jira and Confluence. Experienced in release planning, testing, CI/CD and production support for B2B webshops.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Junior Technical Product Owner Webshop (m/w/d) B2B-Versandhandel
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Jungheinrich Profishop’s reputation for innovative B2B e-commerce and its collaborative culture. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep technical expertise with a proven track record of translating business needs into robust webshop functionalities.

bullets.label: Requirement Engineering
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I gathered and documented user stories, functional specifications and use cases, aligning them with business stakeholders to drive webshop enhancements.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: I designed and exposed OCC REST services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, ensuring seamless integration of product, ERP and MDM data across B2B channels.

bullets.label: Release & Testing
bullets.text: I coordinated CI/CD release cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), performed end-to-end testing and supported production roll-outs, guaranteeing stable webshop performance.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I facilitated communication between product owners, development teams and external partners, maintaining transparent information flow.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Junior Technical Product Owner Webshop (m/w/d) B2B-Versandhandel
cover_de.hook: Die Innovationskraft des Jungheinrich PROFISHOPs und das Ziel, den B2B-Versandhandel weiter zu digitalisieren, begeistern mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen für Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefes technisches Know-how und nachweisliche Erfolge bei der Umsetzung von Webshop-Funktionen mit.

bullets.label: Anforderungs-Engineering
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich Anforderungen, User Stories und Use Cases erfasst und dokumentiert und eng mit den Fachbereichen abgestimmt, um die Webshop-Weiterentwicklung zu steuern.

bullets.label: API- und Integration
bullets.text: Ich habe OCC-REST-Services entwickelt und PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines aufgebaut, um Produkt-, ERP- und MDM-Daten nahtlos in B2B-Kanälen zu integrieren.

bullets.label: Release- und Testing
bullets.text: Ich koordinierte CI/CD-Release-Zyklen auf der SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), führte End-to-End-Tests durch und unterstützte produktive Roll-outs, um stabile Webshop-Leistungen sicherzustellen.

bullets.label: Stakeholder-Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: In meiner techno-funktionalen Rolle stellte ich die transparente Kommunikation zwischen Product Ownern, Entwicklungsteams und externen Dienstleistern sicher.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Über ein persönliches Gespräch freue ich mich.

tailoring.why_company: Jungheinrich Profishop stands out as a market leader that combines logistics expertise with cutting-edge e-commerce solutions. I am drawn to its commitment to continuous innovation and the opportunity to shape a B2B webshop that serves a global customer base. My background in SAP Commerce Cloud, API-driven integrations and stakeholder-focused delivery aligns perfectly with your ambition to set new standards in the Versandhandel.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive innovative B2B webshop solutions at Jungheinrich Profishop, contributing to its growth and digital leadership.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years in B2B e-commerce. I’m very interested in the Junior Technical Product Owner role at Jungheinrich Profishop and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Junior Technical Product Owner Webshop (m/w/d) B2B-Versandhandel
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Junior Technical Product Owner Webshop position. With over five years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to Jungheinrich Profishop’s innovative B2B e-commerce initiatives. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.
